en: "They look like Rhodes army soldiers,{n} but hadn't that lot already pulled{n} out of this island of steel?"
"And Rhodes itself, invaded by{n} Rheinmetall and other countries, should{n} be on the verge of collapse by now?"
"Then why would they be{n} in a place like thiiis?"
"Oh my? Judging by those uniforms,{n} they look like Rhodes army soldiers.{n} Buuut, wasn't the Rhodes army..."
"Right. Invaded by Rheinmetall and{n} the neighboring countries, it should{n} be on the verge of collapse by now."
"Or could they be survivors of the{n} regular army who were left behind{n} on this island, sir?"
"But please look at their eyes.{n} Eyes so full of hope and fight{n} are not those of beaten soldiers."
"Oh my! Those must be enemies too!{n} Leave it to Li'l Tethys, if you please!{n} She'll thrash them easy, yes indeed!"
"I sense a strong killing intent{n} from the soldiers over there.{n} Please do not let your guard down..."
"Prince {hero:6}! Rhodes is the{n} reeeeeeally bad country that{n} made us Esper Dolls!"
"Please! Beat up those people{n} who treat us like dolls!"
"Yet save for memories of my comrades{n} in the Esper Girl Corps, I have, alas,{n} not one good memory of that land."
"You there, do you hear me!?{n} We are the Free Rhodes Army!"
"An independent force of valiant{n} warriors, risen of our own will{n} in our homeland's hour of peril!"
"Heh! The Free Rhodes Army?{n} So why would a volunteer army{n} like you fight us?"
"The Free Rhodes Army, is iiit?{n} But why would people like that{n} fight uuus?"
"Is it not plain!? To save our homeland{n} we must have the Almighty Treasure!{n} We are after the rings you carry!"
"Tch, you talk mighty big, but when{n} it comes down to it, you just{n} want the loot, right?"
"You are wrong! Never do we seek{n} the Almighty Treasure out of{n} selfish greed!"
"We are patriots who rose to defend{n} our beloved homeland from the evil{n} grasp of the tyrant military powers!"
"I see, so that's how it is!"
"Can it be... Parsifal!? The Heavy{n} MG Battalion's mightiest ace,{n} Parsifal the Annihilator!?"
"Parsifal the Annihilator, huh...{n} That takes me back. They did call{n} me that when I was in the army..."
"Oh! What good fortune! Parsifal!{n} Now, for our homeland, let us fight{n} together as the Free Rhodes Army!"
"With you we would have the strength{n} of a hundred! Let us defend Rhodes,{n} our homeland, from the great powers!"
"What do you think I should do?"
"Yeah, I was going to anyway,{n} without you telling me."
"You're one of us. Don't go{n} back to the Rhodes army now."
"Why on earth do you hesitate!? Our{n} homeland may rise or fall! Now is{n} the time to stand as its saviors!"
"Do you say you care not if our{n} homeland perishes!? Our beloved{n} Kingdom of Rhodes!?"
"Dig out your ears and listen gooood!{n} I'm never going back to Rhodes!{n} Homeland? It can eat shit!"
"Are you in your right mind, Parsifal!?"
"'To defend our dying homeland', my{n} ass! I'm never getting suckered{n} by that smooth talk again!"
"Die for my country? Like hell! They{n} order us to land on this island,{n} then pull out the second it goes bad!"
"You know it too, don't you!? How many{n} died in the first landing operation!?"
"We're no chess pieces for the bunch{n} running the country! We're human!{n} Flesh-and-blood humans, you hear!?"
"Why should I defend a country that{n} only barks whatever suits it!?{n} From now on I fight just for myself!"
"I'm Parsifal, a free soldier!{n} I believe in one thing only: the{n} comrades I've faced death beside!"
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!{n} Anyone who wants to die, step up!{n} I'll fill you full of holes on the spot!"
"Very well! Then you are an enemy!{n} A mere bloodthirsty deserter who turns{n} away from the homeland's peril!"
"Damn right! My bullets will smash{n} that country to bits! A country that{n} uses people's lives as stepping stones!"
"Listen up, Free Rhodes Army or{n} whatever you are. If you want{n} the rings, take them."
"Oh my!? Are you suuure?{n} Saying a thing like thaaat?"
"Very well, I shall make corpses of{n} you this instant! Come, then! You{n} outlaws who cast away your country!"
"Their unit is built around firearms!{n} Get in right under their noses!{n} We settle this fast at close range!"
"Anyone who wants to die, step up!{n} My heavy machine gun will send you{n} to the next world fast and painless!"
"They use long-range weapons! It's{n} best if we fight from a distance too,{n} with magic and special attaaacks!"
"Uoooh!? You outlaws! Why must we,{n} the saviors of our country,{n} be killed!?"
"You... fools... do not think...{n} people can live... without a country."
"Garbage! People made the country!{n} What's it doing killing people!?{n} A country is meant to be for people!"
"Then today's Rhodes is no country{n} at all!"
"Fool... if a country... is a gathering{n} of people... its will... is their will...{n} People... wanted people killed."
"Yeah, that's why! That's why I'm{n} fighting of my own will now!"
"A fight to see for myself, by force{n} if need be, the truth called the{n} Almighty Treasure at this island's heart!"
"Meeting {hero:6} is how{n} I found a fight of my own!"
"This is one person's war! Not a{n} country's war that drags in people{n} with no will to fight!"
"I get wanting to protect your country.{n} But that has nothing to do with glory.{n} Confuse the two, and countless die..."
"But people dying because they love{n} it... I just cannot bring myself{n} to think that is right..."
"All right, on to the next battlefield!{n} We've got little time left{n} to collect all the rings!"
"Anyway, let's head for the next plaaace!{n} We have little time left. We must{n} hurry and collect all the riiings!"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
